notes.title: Desktop Portal v1.2.9
notes.content:
Hey guys! Desktop v1.2.9 is here with some QoL improvements and a bunch of bug-fixes!

New features:
- Added an optional SteamVR binding to open the bar
- Added support for opening the bar at an angle while laying down
- Added vertical monitor support
- Updated window capture implementation for better performance and less buggy behavior
- Added new "smooth capture" toolbar button for easily marking overlays as needing to be smooth
- You can recenter by tapping the watch

General:
- Haptics for hovering and clicking on stuff
- Added fancy new font
- You can now scroll with either hand's joystick
- Made overlays consistently curve based on their width
- Increased the consistency at which overlay frames got updated
- Updated analytics implementation

Snap Points:
- Improved preview behavior when hovering over a snap point
- Added a new snap point behind the main one for larger windows

Library:
- Removed irrelevant stuff from showing in the Library

Bug fixes:
- Fixed task launcher breaking if you changed where DP was installed
- Fixed the desktop window randomly getting stuck in certain situations
- Fixed broken tutorial video
- Fixed issue where you couldn't laser down to the toolbar if there was another overlay behind it
- Fixed the hide bar when headset off toggle not doing anything

notes.title: The Future of Desktop Portal
notes.content:
Hey guys! Thanks for using Desktop Portal, if you have been!

[h2]What happened?[/h2]

I wanted to apologize for the lack of development and bugfixing on it in the past months. After releasing Desktop Portal I ended up getting a full-time VR development job, which has been eating away the majority of my time.

To any new potential users reading this, I might recommend using another overlay software till I've had more time to develop (see below).

I've been wanting to fix a lot of the things in Desktop Portal, but it's often just really hard to find time to context switch and develop on it.

My passion for overlay software is still itching at me, but SteamVR's overlay system is difficult to work with, and Desktop Portal itself didn't use the best coding practices when I first made it since I was still learning about development quite a bit myself. This makes it overall somewhat difficult to maintain and add new features quickly.

[h2]What are you going to do about it?[/h2]

At the risk of sounding like every optimistic kickstarter ever, I wanted to mention that I've been working on a new solution to all of this, called Project Lair. Before I say anything, I want to mention that as a thank you/apology to people who've used Desktop Portal/been disappointed by it, I will make Project Lair totally free for them no matter what pricing model I decide to do with it.

[h2]So, what is Project Lair?[/h2]

Project Lair is the ultimate tool for productivity in VR. It uses the same technology for window capture in Desktop Portal (that I've been working to improve) to let you build and customize your own virtual "office" in VR. I want to give a varity of preset environments to work in, or let users build and import their own rooms.

Project Lair can function as it's own standalone app that lets you work in VR, or, with the flick of a switch, transform into a SteamVR overlay, and have your favorite desktop windows follow you into any game. I've been working on some new tech that allows me to do this and almost completely avoid the SteamVR overlay system, which will allow me to do way more cool stuff than before, such as overlaying any 3d models into SteamVR, instead of just flat overlays.

[h2]When is it coming?[/h2]
I don't know. I'm not going to try to give a "release date" when my schedule is as unstable as it is already. It's a passion project I'm working on and building for myself, so the motivation is always there, it's just a matter of time.

As always, you can join the [url=https://discord.gg/adVEQmY]Discord[/url] to stay up to date on all this stuff ^_^

Thanks for (hopefully) understanding, I still have the dream of delivering the best VR overlay software out there!

notes.title: Desktop Portal v1.2
notes.content:
[h3]Hey guys! v1.2 is finally pretty much ready for release! This is the biggest update Desktop Portal has seen by far. To celebrate it, Desktop Portal is 15% off for a limited time![/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/J4KOfoH.png[/img]

[h3]What's new?[/h3][list][*]Fully revamped UI and UX.
[*]New window capture method that allows for super speedy window capture!
[*]Overall performance improvements!
[*]Optional admin task that you can install to be able to capture admin windows!
[*]New window settings (anchoring options, window cropping, distance hiding, and more!)
[*]New keyboard! (only partially implemented)
[*]New library UI!
[*]Completely reworked start menu for Desktop and VR.
[*]Tons of random fixes in the background to make everything just work better :D
[/list]
[h3]Wow, sounds awesome![/h3]You bet. And you can try it today! I've updated the quickstart tutorial if you need help! [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oe0Zm58l3hc]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oe0Zm58l3hc[/url]

[h3]What's next?[/h3]Window layouts are next on my list. It shouldn't take too long!  After that, we'll be looking into no controllers mode, VR sim'ers rejoice! ^_^

Again, I apologize how long this update took, I kept getting distracted by wanting to rework stuff and add new features.

Thanks for using Desktop Portal! If you ever have any suggestions, or need help, join my [url=https://discord.gg/adVEQmY]Discord[/url]!

[h3]Known Issues[/h3][list][*] Keyboard spawn position is a bit weird.
[*] Shift on the keyboard only works about half the time.
[*] Library favorites don't always save properly.
[*] Window cropping can potentially not work.
[/list]

notes.title: Try the Desktop Portal v1.2 Beta!
notes.content:
[h3]What's going on?[/h3]
Hey guys! Sorry I've been absent from updates for so long, I've been hard at work on the future of Desktop Portal.

Cool preview GIF: https://imgur.com/a/sKsRH6P

The UI and UX have been entirely redesigned, and many requested features have been added. Window cropping, anchoring windows to the bar, distance hiding, customizable look hiding, and so much more.

The fabled "Keyboard 2.0" has been implemented partially, with new UI and shift support! (suggestions and numpad coming soon) https://imgur.com/a/lprwsaY

Performance/capture framerates have also massively improved.

[h3]Much wow. Give now.
[/h3]
It's still somewhat buggy and incomplete, but if you're okay with that, head on over to my [url=https://discord.gg/adVEQmY]Discord [/url]and head into #beta-instructions to see how to try the beta release!

Thanks for using Desktop Portal ^_^

notes.title: Desktop Portal v1.1.0
notes.content:
Desktop Portal v1.1.0 is here with some awesome stuff!

New Features:
[list][*] Added a new mode that lets you return focus to the game you're playing when not interacting. (option in settings)
[*] Added option to use a different (slower) capture API (may fix if windows are being weird)
[*] Added a button under the bar to close it easier.
[*] The current game status thingy will now detect games launched from other places.
[*] The bar now closes when you take off your headset.
[*] The wrist watch temp hides when opening the bar.
[*] Doubled maximum size for overlays.
[/list]

Fixes:
[list][*] The primary window no longer gets covered by a game you launch.
[*] Fixed icon not showing for desktop captures.
[*] Fixed the watch song title overlapping with the buttons when you first opened it.
[*] Made window resizing off by default.
[*] Reduced default curve amount when dragging.
[*] Improved reliability of the bar closing when you open the SteamVR dashboard.
[*] Having window resizing off didn't apply for when you launched an app.
[*] When you launch a window, it no longer shows in the list of possible windows to open.
[*] Maybe improved stability when opening a window on snap points.
[*] Disabled shift key on keyboard since it was breaking stuff for now.
[/list]

Thanks for using Desktop Portal!
